pages.title: Moving without Loss
pages.text: Unbind your pet from its home and successfully bind it to another free home.

pages.title: Moving without Loss
pages.text: Bowls, kibble and name tags furnish the new address while preserving the same pet and owner.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Right-click a home and choose Bind or Unbind after selecting your pet. Each home holds one pet. Both sizes accept any supported animal; large creatures use a nearby safe position around the home’s level.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Unbind clears the previous home without cloning the entity; the same pet can be assigned to another free home.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: A home holds one pet; an occupied home never silently replaces its resident.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: A recovered pet waits at home until its owner right-clicks it; merely owning a home does not enable following.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Holding suppresses only owner-teleport behavior the species already had; the home does not grant dog-like teleportation to every animal.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Hitbox size does not block binding; safe nearby placement uses full creature clearance around home level, including a surface above a buried home.
